integrity: The proof is symbolic and reduces the graph to support disjointness in a finite product of fields. Exhaustive checks on nine small direct products are included only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to reduced commutative Artinian rings.
No claim is made for nonreduced Artinian rings or for a classification of all paired dominating sets.
title: Paired domination of zero-divisor graphs of reduced Artinian rings
